newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht jumps further offshore, interbank steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht jumps further offshore, interbank steady.

text.p: The Thai baht on Friday jumped against the dollar further in the offshore market as foreign players sought baht hungrily to cover short positions and dumped the greenback for it in the spot market, dealers said.

For the second day runing, the baht/dollar spot rate offshore was at its highest since the baht was last devalued in 1984. Offshore, the baht was traded around 23.770/23.870 to the dollar early compared with 24.00/24.10 late on Thursday.
"Offshore players appeared to still face a severe shortage of baht," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
